identity.title: [CI][runners] Make larger-runner eligibility branch-independent and observable

values.goal: Make larger-runner eligibility branch-independent while retaining repository scope and providing fast native diagnostics for capacity versus policy failures.
values.required_outcome: A typed read-only Rust preflight proves runner label and capacity, group visibility, selected repository access, workflow restriction state, and stale workflow references, while PR branches remain eligible without allowlist mutation.
authority_boundary: GitHub organization runner and runner-group settings remain external authority.
The preflight is read-only and reports observed state without mutating it.
Repository scoping remains mandatory while workflow restriction must be disabled for branch-independent eligibility.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue changes on main.
Use Rust and existing COTS crates; do not add shell or Python control-plane logic.
